subject: social
title: Community Helpers
about: What a community is and the people whose jobs keep it running: firefighters, mail carriers, farmers, doctors, teachers and more. NC 1.C&G.1.1: individuals and groups who shape communities.
tip: On a drive, point at a truck or building and ask which helper works there.

cards.q: What do we call a place where people live, work and play together?
cards.note: Your town or neighborhood is a community.
Firefighters spray water from big hoses on the fire truck.

cards.q: Who helps when you are lost and keeps the town safe?
cards.note: A police officer is a safe grown-up to ask for help.

cards.q: Who brings letters and packages to your home?
cards.note: Mail carriers bring mail to every house, rain or shine.

cards.q: Who grows the food we eat?
cards.note: Farmers grow fruits and vegetables and care for farm animals.

cards.q: Who helps you get better when you are sick?
cards.note: Doctors check your body and help you feel well.

cards.q: Who checks and cleans your teeth?
cards.note: Visit the dentist to keep your teeth strong and clean.

cards.q: Who helps you learn at school?
cards.note: Teachers help you read, write and count.

cards.q: Who helps you find books at the library?
cards.note: Librarians help you find and borrow books.

cards.q: Who drives kids safely to school?
cards.note: Bus drivers stop at each bus stop so kids can ride safely.

cards.q: Who takes away the trash each week?
cards.note: Trash collectors are also called sanitation workers.

cards.q: Who takes care of sick animals?
cards.note: Vet is short for veterinarian, a doctor for animals.
Construction workers use tools and big machines to build.

cards.q: Who helps kids cross the street safely?
cards.note: A crossing guard holds up a sign so cars stop for you.
Bakers get up early to make fresh bread.
Pilots sit at the front of the plane in the cockpit.

cards.q: Who fixes leaky pipes and sinks?
cards.note: Plumbers fix pipes so water runs in your home.

cards.q: Who cares for you at the hospital along with the doctor?
cards.note: Nurses check your temperature and help you feel better.
